title: MCP Enduser Test
goal: Manual end-user validation of Pros MCP installation and setup flow without changing global MCP/client configuration unless explicitly approved.

included: fresh or selected case folder setup
Pros runtime manifest MCP target review
optional SSOT/sync only after explicit approval
excluded: provider OAuth setup with pasted secrets
AnythingLLM writes unless explicitly selected and approved

constraints: Never request or record secrets, tokens, OAuth codes, passwords, API keys, or Credential Manager values.
Do not modify servers.yaml or client configs without explicit user approval.
Validate Serena workspace binding through .serena/project.yml and logs before changing OpenCode config.
Use pros-runtime-manifest.md as the MCP target-state reference.
The user executes tests manually; the assistant gives one step at a time.

tasks.title: Define test conditions and target clients
acceptanceCriteria: OpenCode and AnythingLLM targets selected or skipped

tasks.title: Prepare fresh or selected case folder
acceptanceCriteria: case folder exists outside the source repository

tasks.title: Run pros init and inspect MCP-relevant artifacts
acceptanceCriteria: local opencode.json was not created by default

tasks.title: Review runtime manifest and MCP workflow
Verify Serena and OpenCode workspace binding
acceptanceCriteria: OpenCode MCP status checked when available
latest Serena log activates the case folder
fallback to user profile is documented if observed

tasks.title: Check Pros-MCP binaries and integration readiness
acceptanceCriteria: pros-mcp-* binaries are on PATH or missing state is documented

tasks.title: Run werkzeuge-mcp-einrichtung to the approval gate
acceptanceCriteria: workflow checks .serena/project.yml before global config fixes

tasks.title: Prepare SSOT plan without writing it
acceptanceCriteria: no secrets appear in args, env, YAML, or client snippets

tasks.title: Optionally sync after explicit approval
acceptanceCriteria: servers.yaml changes are approved before writing
each MCP target has a documented result state

tasks.title: Document results and blockers
acceptanceCriteria: test path, runtime source, client targets, logs, binary status, and blockers are documented

doneWhen: case folder and runtime source are documented
Serena/OpenCode activates the case folder or failure is logged
no global MCP/client config was changed without approval
